description: Use this when the user wants to pause automatic replies from the salon text AI receptionist. Accepts salonId. Saves a proposed change setting the text agent enabled state to false and returns its change ID and before/after preview. Preparation does not pause replies. Apply the saved change with beautyos_apply_change only after the user confirms. Pausing leaves messaging channel connections and the subscription in place.
name: beautyos_agent_pause_prepare
title: Preview agent pause
